name: Burn Fragment
body:
Price 500 gp (basic), 2,000 gp (standard), 5,000 gp (grand); Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st; Slot none; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This small stone lacks any identifying feature except for a pale glow inside of it, feeling warm to the touch. When held, it allows the holder to use a swift action to reduce the burn cost of a wild talent of 3rd level or lower by 1, to a minimum of 0. After it is used, the burn fragment is instantly destroyed. A standard burn fragment can be used with a wild talent of 6th level or lower, while a greater burn fragment can be used with a wild talent of 9th level or lower.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 250 gp (basic), 1,000 gp (standard), 2,500 gp (greater); Feats Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist 1st
